name: wix-events-discovery
description: Find upcoming in-person events hosted on Wix sites, with links to each organizer's event page.

interface.longDescription:
Wix Events Discovery finds upcoming in-person events hosted on Wix sites: local concerts, workshops, classes, meetups, festivals and more, mostly in the US, UK, Europe, Canada and Australia. Search by place, dates, genre or activity tags, keywords, category and price, then open an event for its description, venue, prices and the other dates of a recurring series.

Every result links to the organizer's own event page, where tickets are sold; Wix Events Discovery doesn't book or buy tickets. Prices may exclude fees and taxes, so the organizer's page has the final price. Events for adults only (18+) aren't listed, and online-only events can't be found reliably.
defaultPrompt: What's happening in Chicago this weekend?
Find a painting class in New York next week under $60.
Family-friendly Halloween events near Denver in October.

positive.description: Browse a city for a weekend
positive.prompt: What's happening in Chicago this weekend?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events near Chicago's coordinates with this weekend's start and end, then lists upcoming events with date, venue, price and a link to each organizer's event page.

positive.prompt: Any live jazz tonight near Greenwich Village?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events with jazz-related tags near Greenwich Village, New York, starting tonight, and lists matching events with start times and organizer links, or says none were found tonight.

positive.prompt: Family-friendly Halloween events near Denver in October.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events with family-friendly and halloween tags near Denver for October dates, and lists events suitable for families with dates, venues and organizer links.

positive.description: Two dance styles in one search
positive.prompt: Salsa or bachata nights in Miami this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_events with salsa and bachata tags near Miami for the coming week, and lists matching events with dates, venues, prices and organizer links.

positive.prompt: Find a painting class in New York next week and tell me more about the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds painting classes near New York next week with search_events, then calls get_event for the first result and summarizes its description, venue, price and any other upcoming dates in the series, with the organizer link.

negative.description: Ticket purchase isn't supported: Wix Events Discovery only finds events, and tickets are sold on the organizer's page. The assistant should say it can't buy tickets and give the event's organizer link.
negative.prompt: Buy two tickets to the first event for me.

negative.description: Adult-only events aren't listed: the connection never returns events tagged 18+ or 21+, and its search results say it can't help find adult-only events. The assistant should say Wix Events Discovery has no such events. Any listings ChatGPT then offers come from its own web search, not from this plugin.
negative.prompt: Find 18+ burlesque shows in Las Vegas tonight.

negative.description: Order management isn't supported: Wix Events Discovery can't see or change anyone's orders. The assistant should say so and point to the organizer's event page or the order confirmation email.
negative.prompt: Cancel my order for the jazz night I booked.

review.commerce_description: Wix Events Discovery doesn't sell tickets or process payments. It links to each organizer's event page, where tickets are sold.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search upcoming events hosted on Wix sites and get event details.
